note: Qwen3.5 122B A10B APEX I-Compact MoE: about 59.2 GB (55.1 GiB) for the text GGUF. Use the ROCm llama.cpp runtime with GPU offload Auto first; keep K at Q8 for coding/search and use V Q4 only when RAM or context pressure requires it. The model card recommends Jinja and enable_thinking=false for fast interactive work.
warning: The optional mmproj file is not needed for coding or web search. Thinking mode can greatly increase latency; the first interactive smoke test should use a bounded max_tokens value.

note: ROCMFPX GGUF type may be unsupported by the current AtomicBot/TurboTan builds.
warning: Previously failed with invalid ggml type 103. Prefer normal Q4_K_M/Q5_K_M/Q6_K/Q8_0 GGUF instead.

note: Ternary/Q2_0 (group 128) Bonsai model: requires the PrismML-Eng/llama.cpp fork (PrismBonsai engine). Mainline llama.cpp cannot load Q2_0_g128. Use q8_0 K cache, q4_0 V cache (asymmetric), FlashAttention On. Skip the mmproj file unless using multimodal. On 16 GB VRAM (RX 7800 XT, gfx1101) the 27B Q2_0 model is tight when paired with the deep-research harness and llama-agent running back-to-back against a single np=1 slot. Prefer context_tokens=16384 and cache_ram_mib=4096 for DeepResearch / LlamaAgent to leave headroom so warmup does not overflow VRAM before the first client request.
warning: Do NOT run these with AtomicBot/TurboTan/Official* engines; loading fails with invalid ggml type. Use the complete matching build from the PrismML-Eng fork (HIP build-rocm71 on RX 7800 XT). If llama-server crashes right after printing 'server is listening on http://127.0.0.1:8080', lower cache_ram_mib before retrying; a ghost gateway PID left on 8090 will keep returning TypeError: fetch failed until Stop-LlamaDockSupervisor clears it.

note: TQ3 model: use TurboTan, K=q8_0, V=tq3_0. Thinking is disabled by default so Odysseus receives normal content.
MTP model: Speculative MTP/NextN can be tested with draft-mtp when the model actually includes MTP heads.
MoE model: keep MoE experts on Auto first. Try 2 or 3 manually after the model boots cleanly.
Gemma-family model: good lightweight fallback. Use Flash Attention on and keep Deep Research extraction concurrency modest.
Coder model: better suited for Cline/coding than prose-heavy Deep Research.

MiniMax H3 は llama-server で動くテキスト LLM ではなく、ComfyUI で使う 33B の動画・音声生成 DiT（拡散モデル、アーキテクチャ minimax_h3）です。llama-server の起動フローは関係ありません。ComfyUI（http://127.0.0.1:8188）にモデルを置いて使います（既定の配置: ComfyUI の extra_model_paths.yaml で .lmstudio\models\MiniMax-H3 を参照）。fl2va = テキスト/先頭フレーム→動画+音声、ref2va = 参照条件付き生成。量子化は Q8_0 / Q5_1 / Q5_0 / Q4_0 のみ（hidden width 2688 のため K 量子化は不可）。テキストエンコーダ GGUF（Qwen3-VL-32B + mmproj）と VAE も別途必要です。**R2V（参照モード）**: ComfyUI の models\loras\ に `minimax_h3_ref_lora_rank_256_bf16.safetensors`（Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental の loras/、約 1.9GB）を置き、fl2va モデルに LoraLoaderModelOnly で重ねると ref2va モデル無しで参照条件付き生成ができます（h3_workflow_r2v*.json・h3-chat の 🔗 参照モード）。Spectrum 併用はオフ推奨・4-8step。
warning: llama-server / AtomicBot / TurboTan / PrismBonsai で起動しないでください（ComfyUI 専用モデル）。GGUF 版は ComfyUI 0.30.0+ で ComfyUI-GGUF + ComfyUI-H3-Multishot v1.5.2+（ネイティブ版は MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 ノード）が必須。エンコーダが無いと生成できません。
